resources.string: Only the event\'s icon (and a ring for the battery level) in the capsule. Nothing grows and no text is hidden by the camera. The capsule\'s accessibility description still says what happened.
The pill grows downward and the text sits in a row under the camera hole, so nothing is hidden.
The pill stays short and its text is split into two halves either side of the camera hole. Long titles may be cut off.
